0022600123.text: The Milwaukee Bucks, who are 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Indiana Pacers, who are 2-1 and riding a one-game win streak, in Milwaukee's fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Milwaukee sits fifth in the Central and 13th in the East, while Indiana is second in the Central and fifth in the East. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), all out, and Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bucks won all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently 134-123 in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
